description: Single view composed solely of repeated circular marks arranged along a horizontal baseline. Circles are equal size and stacked vertically into multiple columns across the width, with varying stack heights and gaps between columns. No additional data-encoding layers (lines/bands/areas) besides these circles.

primary.explanation: Columns of stacked circles across the horizontal baseline; estimated 16 columns.

secondary.explanation: Heights of stacks per column vary; counts sorted ascending for 2D_LIST.
